subject: general
question:
Select the correct idiom to substitute the underlined segment in the following sentence.

Sean is notorious for __revealing the secrets__ about the company.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"notorious"** means being famous or well-known for some bad quality or deed. (कुख्यात)

 
 
• **Example: **He is notorious for always being late to meetings.
 
 
 
• **"Spilling the beans"** refers to revealing secret information unintentionally or indiscreetly. (भेद खोल देना)
 
 
• **Example: **She accidentally spilled the beans about the surprise party.
 
 
 
• Hence, the idiom that fits best in the context of the sentence is **"spilling the beans"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Being in bad blood** (दुश्मनी में होना): To have ill feelings or hatred towards someone.

 
 
• **Example:** There has been bad blood between the two families for years.
 
 
 
• **Biting the bullet** (कठिन परिस्थिति का सामना करना): To endure a painful or otherwise unpleasant situation that is seen as unavoidable.
 
 
• **Example: **She decided to bite the bullet and accept the transfer to another city.
 
 
 
• **Biting the dust** (मृत्यु को प्राप्त होना): To fail or to be defeated.
 
 
• **Example:** Many startups bite the dust within their first few years.
